_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Line 5. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. Only packages whose source was read are listed; Wikipedia names more (CA-166 track, CA-239 power, CA-242 fare collection, CA-246 finishing), which wait for a source.

tenders.scope: Part design and construction of the viaduct and stations from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, 12.811 km
tenders.notes: Other bidders included Larsen & Toubro and NCC. The report gives no contract value.

tenders.scope: Kasheli depot: stabling yard, sheds, workshops, operation control centre, administrative building and staff quarters
tenders.awarded_value_note: Lowest bid Rs 597.56 crore (March 2023), 26.6% above the estimate; awarded at Rs 589.56 crore.

tenders.scope: Rolling stock (22 six-car trains), CBTC signalling and train control, telecom, platform screen doors, and depot machinery at Kasheli
tenders.notes: Bids invited in February 2024 at an estimate of Rs 2,640.72 crore; Titagarh lowest bidder in June 2025 (The Metro Rail Guy); letter of acceptance announced on 31 Oct 2025. Maintenance term reported as 5 years (award reports) or 15 years after a 2-year defect period (tender).
